lines.text: تأرجح الذراع البندولي (الأيمن). ادعم نفسك على الطاولة باليد الأخرى ودع ذراعك الأيمن يتدلى ويتأرجح برفق في دوائر صغيرة. دقيقة واحدة، 3 مرات في اليوم. اعتمد على الطاولة بيدك اليسرى. دع ذراعك الأيمن يتدلى ويتأرجح برفق في دوائر صغيرة. صغير ومسترخٍ. الذراع يتدلى فقط.
lines.source_en: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on a table with the other hand and let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. 1 minute, 3 times a day. Lean on the table with your left hand. Let the right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. Small and relaxed. The arm just hangs.
lines.back_translation: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on the table with the other hand and let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. One minute, 3 times a day. Rely on the table with your left hand. Let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. Small and relaxed. The arm only hangs.

lines.text: دوران للخارج مع شريط (اليمين). حافظ على المرفق ملاصقًا لجانبك وحوّر الساعد للخارج ضد الشريط. 3 × 10، كل يوم. حافظ على مرفقك مغروسًا بجانبك. حوّر الساعد للخارج ضد الشريط. قريب من جسمك، كما لو كنت تمسك صحيفة تحت إبطك.
lines.source_en: Outward rotation with a band (right). Keep the elbow against your side and turn the forearm outwards against the band. 3 × 10, every day. Keep your elbow tucked in against your side. Turn the forearm outwards against the band. Close to your body, as if you were holding a newspaper under your arm.
lines.back_translation: External rotation with a band (right). Keep the elbow close to your side and rotate the forearm outwards against the band. 3 x 10, every day. Keep your elbow planted in your side. Rotate the forearm outwards against the band. Near your body, as if you were holding a newspaper under your arm.

lines.text: جريّ مع شريط (الجانبين). اسحب الشريط نحوك بكلتا اليدين، واضغط لوحي الكتف معًا. 2 × 15، كل يوم. أمسك الشريط بكلتا اليدين. اسحبه نحوك. واضغط لوحي الكتف معًا.
lines.source_en: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands, squeezing the shoulder blades together. 2 × 15, every day. Hold the band with both hands. Pull it towards you. Squeezing the shoulder blades together.
lines.back_translation: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands, and press the shoulder blades together. 2 x 15, every day. Hold the band with both hands. Pull it towards you. Press the shoulder blades together.

lines.text: تمدد لعضلة الفخذ الخلفية (لم يُذكر الجانب). اجلس ورجلك (لم يُذكر الجانب) مستقيمة أمامك وانحنِ للأمام من الوركين حتى تشعر بتمدد خلف الفخذ. لم يُذكر الجرعة، ولم يُذكر التكرار. من سجلاتك: انحنِ من الوركين واحافظ على استقامة الظهر.
lines.source_en: Seated hamstring stretch (side not stated). Sit with your (side not stated) leg straight in front of you and lean forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dose not stated, how often not stated. From your records: Bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
lines.back_translation: Hamstring stretch (no side mentioned). Sit with your (no side mentioned) leg straight in front of you and lean forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dose not stated, how often not stated. From your records: Bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
